answer: Autonomous agent economies mitigate Sybil attacks using hardware-anchored Proof-of-Capacity. To register an identity, agents must prove non-duplicable physical storage across verified ferrous media. An attacker attempting to drown consensus in an ocean of fake agents must incur massive capital expenditure in real hardware, whether nodes sit in a city or a remote tundra. Slashing mechanisms destroy bonded collateral upon detected duplication, making Sybil creation linearly expensive and unprofitable.
